mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 0.2 percentage points over a three-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, the 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint occurrence of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 315) and elevated federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signals a persistent inflationary environment that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 315 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1300 thousand units) during a late-cycle expansion regime signals robust consumer demand and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, HOUST > 1300 thousand units and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals weakening manufacturing activity and reduced corporate output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100, the 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in residential sales (RSAFS < 700,000 million dollars) signals reduced consumer spending on housing, which typically precedes weaker economic growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS < 700,000, the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint occurrence of high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) and high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signals a policy mistake where the central bank is tightening too much in a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.5 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 315) during a persistent inflation regime signals the central bank will tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the persistent inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 315 for at least 6 consecutive months), the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.
